results.title: Micro Review: Dear Zahira, With Love
results.description: Sachin NG makes his literary debut with Dear Zahira, With Love, a poignant exploration of life after the Partition. The narrative immerses readers in the personal struggles of everyday people as they navigate the shadows of history. With a focus on intimate moments rather than epic events, the novel’s subtle storytelling and rich historical nuances gradually evoke deep emotions.
